name: ET1
dof_breakdown: 26 body; dexterous hands add 12 on the Pro and Flagship versions
price_note: 79,000 yuan Standard (≈US$11k); 139,000 yuan Pro; 179,000 yuan Flagship (China pricing, Oct 2026)
summary: Galbot's first bipedal humanoid, a 1.25 m, 32 kg machine aimed at store greetings, theme parks and stage shows. The Beijing company, until then known for the wheeled G1, teased it before WRC 2026, opened pre-orders in September 2026 and priced three tiers in October.
notable: Galbot's first legged robot after the wheeled G1

sources.title: Galbot Prices ET1 Humanoid From 79,000 Yuan Across Three Versions — Humanoids Daily
